clips.title: The story
paras: Elu is an apprentice wind rider stationed atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Eager to begin his formal training and take to the skies, he tasks Horde travelers with retrieving wild wyvern eggs from nearby roosts.

Perched high above the salt flats and canyon floor at Freewind Post, Elu spends his days tending to the settlement's aerial mounts while dreaming of his own flight. As a young tauren apprentice, he longs to join the ranks of the master wind riders who patrol the towering mesas of Kalimdor. Before he can begin true flight training, however, he must prove his capability by supplying the roost with fresh wyvern stock, sending capable adventurers to harvest intact eggs from the fierce wild wyverns nesting at Highperch.
